name: windows_x86_64
title: Windows x86_64 (MinGW-w64)
description: P174: LambLisp as a native Windows LambLisp.exe, cross-built from Linux with the MinGW-w64 toolchain.  MinGW-w64 rather than MSVC because the codebase is written against GCC (__attribute__ format/inline, __builtin_*, -Wl,--wrap=), so MSVC would add a second, unrelated porting problem on top of the platform one.  Phase 1 is a LANGUAGE demo: no sockets, no raw terminal, no native code generator.
